question: For the 13 original SOXX NPORT disclosure baskets in 2019-2022, can the existing Qlib constituent-price provider support the prespecified 20-session member-price inputs without dropping or renormalizing any reported equity?
identity_gate: For every one of 390 original EC rows, require the same accession and original USD fair value in the legacy ticker bridge. Non-placeholder CUSIP must also match exactly. Preserve 000000000/N/A original CUSIP placeholders as name-and-value-only ticker identity, unqualified for a strict all-member feature; never infer cross-report identity from a placeholder.
price_gate: Use native qlib.init, D.calendar and one bounded D.features read of $adj_close on available ticker instruments for 2019-10-01 through 2022-12-30. For each next-session signal with an NPORT report, require the member's signal-date close plus 20 prior actual Qlib session closes, all positive finite. Count exact full-basket days, strict-CUSIP full-basket days, missing members and missing original equity weight without renormalization. Do not compute returns, labels, model fits or a strategy account.
timing_and_vintage: Only already-filed report baskets enter each signal day. Existing provider prices were assembled from retrospective Yahoo/other sources and historical first-received adjusted-close vintages are not certified; mark this separate qualification gap even if numerical coverage passes.
stop: Any source hash, 390-row identity/value mismatch, timing, Qlib price or Recorder/NAS failure stops qualification. Do not compact to surviving members or change the 20-session window. A pass here is price availability only and cannot authorize an information fit without full 2011-2022 Stage1 and held-source timing.
